prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a high fidelity single desktop application screen for 在场, a warm intelligent companion for university life. This is an exploratory real-use UI design, not a splash screen, not a collage or contact sheet. Landscape 1536x1024.
Reference image 1 supplies only the refined literary anime painting, wood and soft textile, natural daylight, and character identity; do NOT copy its room camera or window-seat layout. Reference image 2 supplies the user-selected youthful face of Sakiko Togawa; reference 3 is her simplified meme-cat expression, one coherent anime head plus line-drawn cat body. Do not crop the face from the room.
Task: the user has just sent a mathematical question and now reads a substantial continuous answer alongside two source documents. Invent a purpose-built close conversation composition, “lamp at the edge of our table”. Bring the point of view into the table and nearby lamp, open book and soft curtain reflection; the environment is in the outer edges, with a broad calm full-height reading surface organically occupying most of the viewport. The content belongs in the composition from the beginning. Preserve depth and craft, without an illustrated room behind a giant grey rectangle. Avoid chat bubbles for every paragraph, box inside box, excessive glass, floating blocks and ornamental controls. Navigation has 在场 then 聊天 今天 留下, search and small portrait. A single consistent composer below the reading flow, with attachment and send controls.
Actual content to organize in elegant Chinese typography:
user: 为什么二阶方程需要两个初始条件？这两份讲义讲的是同一件事吗？
two identifiable sources near the question: 微分方程讲义 · 第12页 ; 相空间笔记 · 第3页
assistant byline 祥子, with small independent portrait; the message reads as one coherent typographic document:
先把“位置”和“速度”分开看。
只知道某一刻在哪里，还不能决定它接下来往哪边走。二阶方程给出加速度与当前状态的关系；要选出一条具体的运动轨迹，还需要起点的位置与速度。
For y″ + y = 0:
y(t) = A cos t + B sin t
y(0) = A,  y′(0) = B
这里的 A 和 B 并非额外添加的限制，而是所有解之间的两种独立差别。初始条件把这两个自由量确定下来。
两份材料怎样相认
左边的讲义把它写成二阶方程；相空间笔记则把同一件事写成两个一阶方程：x′ = v，v′ = −x。它们描述同一条轨迹，只是选择了不同表示。
A slim readable small curve diagram can follow in the flow. A selected phrase “两个自由量” offers a short local “问这句” affordance, not another global toolbar. Bottom composer draft: “如果只给位置，会剩下哪些可能？”
Sakiko participates as a modest close portrait/upper figure naturally seated at the far edge of the table, NOT an enormous mascot taking half the screen. She has blue-lilac long hair, golden eyes, navy hair ribbons; youthful intelligent face with softly full cheeks, light jaw, no mature fashion-model lips. Navy cardigan, light collar, navy plaid skirt, below-knee calf socks with uncovered knees and loafers if legs visible. Project original outfit, not official uniform. She was reading her own book and has just paused with one finger keeping the page; glance goes to the common paper with a small interested lift of brow, not an empty pointing hand. Optional small cat rests at one edge without obscuring text. One character identity, no duplicated full people.
Give design model real freedom for composition and integration. No green UI, no gradients washing out a cover image, no leg/body defects, no brand slogans, no dashboard metrics, no giant title dominating body. Readable mature interface, youthful expressive character.
review: 主代理亲看：新的桌边机位和青春近景成立；但人物过大，正文仍成右侧大白板，灰公式块与用户框仍重复。仅保留共同桌面与近谈关系，不直接作为运行背景；后续与连续展读方案比较。
